# Fidelity Investments

> Fidelity Investments provides brokerage, retirement, wealth management, trading, and personal finance services for individual investors and institutions.

Fidelity.com combines investing accounts, retirement planning, market research, trading tools, managed solutions, and educational resources. The site includes product overviews, account information, planning guidance, screeners, research, and customer support content.

## Core Investing
- [Open an Account](https://www.fidelity.com/open-account/overview): Overview of brokerage, retirement, cash management, and education savings account options.
- [Brokerage Account](https://www.fidelity.com/trading/the-fidelity-account): Details on Fidelity's standard brokerage account for investing and trading.
- [Cash Management Account](https://www.fidelity.com/spend-save/fidelity-cash-management-account/overview): Banking-style cash management account with spending, saving, and cash features.
- [Managed Accounts](https://www.fidelity.com/managed-accounts/overview): Overview of professionally managed investing and advisory account offerings.
- [Why Fidelity](https://www.fidelity.com/why-fidelity/overview): Summary of Fidelity's investing platform, pricing, tools, and service features.

## Retirement
- [Retirement Planning](https://www.fidelity.com/retirement/retirement-planning): Planning resources for saving, income strategies, and retirement readiness.
- [Retirement Accounts](https://www.fidelity.com/retirement-ira/overview): Overview of IRA and retirement account choices for different goals.
- [Roth IRA](https://www.fidelity.com/retirement-ira/roth-ira): Roth IRA features, eligibility, contribution rules, and tax considerations.
- [Traditional IRA](https://www.fidelity.com/retirement-ira/traditional-ira): Traditional IRA overview including tax treatment and contribution basics.
- [Rollover IRA](https://www.fidelity.com/retirement-ira/401k-rollover-ira): Information on rolling over workplace retirement savings into an IRA.
- [Retirement Income](https://www.fidelity.com/retirement-planning/overview): Resources for building income strategies and managing withdrawals in retirement.

## Trading
- [Trading Overview](https://www.fidelity.com/trading/overview): Entry point for stocks, ETFs, options, and active trader tools.
- [Stocks](https://www.fidelity.com/trading/stocks/overview): Stock trading information, tools, and educational resources.
- [ETFs](https://www.fidelity.com/etfs/overview): ETF investing overview with product information, screeners, and research.
- [Options Trading](https://www.fidelity.com/options-trading/overview): Options trading basics, approval levels, and platform tools.
- [Active Trader Pro](https://www.fidelity.com/trading/advanced-trading-tools/active-trader-pro/overview): Download and overview for Fidelity's advanced desktop trading platform.
- [Trading Dashboard](https://www.fidelity.com/trading/trading-dashboard): Browser-based trading workspace for monitoring markets and placing trades.

## Mutual Funds and Fixed Income
- [Mutual Funds Overview](https://www.fidelity.com/mutual-funds/overview): Mutual fund investing hub with research, screeners, and fund information.
- [Fidelity Funds](https://www.fidelity.com/mutual-funds/fidelity-funds/overview): Overview of Fidelity-managed mutual fund offerings.
- [Fixed Income, Bonds & CDs](https://www.fidelity.com/fixed-income-bonds/overview): Fixed income investing overview for bonds, CDs, and bond ladders.
- [Bond Funds](https://www.fidelity.com/mutual-funds/investing-ideas/bond-funds): Educational and product information for bond mutual funds.
- [Money Market Funds](https://www.fidelity.com/mutual-funds/money-market-funds/overview): Overview of money market mutual funds and cash alternatives.

## Research and Market Data
- [News & Research](https://www.fidelity.com/news/overview): Central hub for market news, investment research, and analysis tools.
- [Markets & Sectors](https://www.fidelity.com/markets-sectors/overview): Market performance, sector data, and investing insights.
- [Stock Research Center](https://www.fidelity.com/stock-trading/stock-market-research): Research tools, screeners, and analysis for stocks.
- [ETF Research Center](https://www.fidelity.com/etfs/fidelity-etfs): ETF research and product exploration tools.
- [Mutual Fund Research](https://www.fidelity.com/fund-screener/research.shtml): Fund screener and research tools for mutual funds.
- [Learning Center](https://www.fidelity.com/learning-center/overview): Educational articles, videos, webinars, and investing guidance.

## Planning and Advice
- [Planning & Advice](https://www.fidelity.com/what-we-offer/planning): Overview of digital planning tools and advisor-supported planning services.
- [Financial Planning](https://www.fidelity.com/what-we-offer/planning/overview): Planning resources for goals, cash flow, retirement, and investing.
- [Wealth Management](https://www.fidelity.com/wealth-management/overview): Wealth management services for complex financial planning and portfolio management.
- [Guidance Center](https://www.fidelity.com/go/guidance): Personalized planning tools and next-step recommendations.
- [Life Events](https://www.fidelity.com/learning-center/life-events/life-events): Guidance for major financial decisions across life stages and milestones.

## Saving and Spending
- [Spend & Save Overview](https://www.fidelity.com/spend-save/overview): Fidelity products and tools for saving, spending, and cash management.
- [Cash Management Account](https://www.fidelity.com/spend-save/fidelity-cash-management-account/overview): Account features for payments, ATM access, and cash organization.
- [Credit Cards](https://www.fidelity.com/spend-save/visa-signature-card): Fidelity Rewards credit card information and benefits overview.
- [Health Savings Account (HSA)](https://www.fidelity.com/go/hsa/why-hsa): HSA overview with tax advantages, investing, and healthcare spending features.
- [529 College Savings Plans](https://www.fidelity.com/529-plans/overview): Education savings plan overview for college and other qualified expenses.

## Workplace and Institutional
- [Workplace Investing](https://www.fidelity.com/go/workplace-investing/overview): Access point for employer-sponsored retirement and workplace benefits resources.
- [401(k) Overview](https://www.fidelity.com/go/401k): Information and access for workplace retirement plan participants.
- [NetBenefits](https://nb.fidelity.com/public/nb/default/home): Workplace benefits portal for retirement plans, stock plans, and health benefits.
- [Stock Plan Services](https://www.fidelity.com/go/stock-plan-services/overview): Resources for equity compensation, employee stock plans, and participants.
- [Fidelity Institutional](https://institutional.fidelity.com/app/home): Institutional platform for advisors, firms, and workplace plan sponsors.

## Customer Service and Support
- [Customer Service](https://www.fidelity.com/customer-service/overview): Help center for account support, contact options, and common tasks.
- [Contact Us](https://www.fidelity.com/customer-service/contact-us): Phone numbers, chat, and contact methods for Fidelity support.
- [FAQs](https://www.fidelity.com/customer-service/faqs): Frequently asked questions about accounts, trading, and services.
- [Forms & Applications](https://www.fidelity.com/customer-service/forms-applications/all-forms): Searchable library of account forms and applications.
- [Security Center](https://www.fidelity.com/security/overview): Information on account protection, fraud prevention, and online security practices.

## Insights and Education
- [Viewpoints](https://www.fidelity.com/viewpoints/overview): Fidelity articles and commentary on markets, retirement, and personal finance.
- [Personal Finance](https://www.fidelity.com/learning-center/personal-finance/overview): Educational content on budgeting, debt, saving, and financial basics.
- [Investing Ideas](https://www.fidelity.com/viewpoints/investing-ideas/overview): Articles and perspectives on portfolio construction and investment themes.
- [Retirement Insights](https://www.fidelity.com/viewpoints/retirement/overview): Retirement-focused articles on saving, income, and planning decisions.
- [Market Insights](https://www.fidelity.com/viewpoints/market-and-economic-insights/overview): Commentary on markets, the economy, and current investing conditions.
